title: Faster zlib/DEFLATE decompression on the Apple M1 (and x86)
relevance: Describes chunkcopy optimization and overlap with decode latency. Shows ~6% speedup from overlapping mispredict latency with copy operations.

title: Introducing Iguana: extremely fast SIMD-optimized decompression
relevance: Demonstrates 13 GB/s decompression on AVX-512 using a format specifically designed for SIMD. Shows the upper bound of what SIMD-friendly decompression can achieve.

title: The Fastest, Safest PNG Decoder in the World
relevance: Wuffs PNG decoder using SIMD-accelerated zlib decompression. Shows 1.22-2.75x faster than libpng through all-at-once decompression and SIMD copies.

title: An Efficient High-Throughput LZ77-Based Decompressor in Reconfigurable Logic
relevance: FPGA-based LZ77 decompressor using 'refine and recycle' method. Demonstrates hardware approaches to parallel LZ77 copy that inform software SIMD strategies.
